610	static Tensor peer_head_backward(
611	    const Tensor& peer_input, const Tensor& g,
612	    const Tensor& Wq, const Tensor& A, const Tensor& B,
613	    const Tensor& expert_W1, const Tensor& expert_b1,
614	    const Tensor& expert_W2, const Tensor& expert_b2,
615	    int64_t d_model, int64_t pk_dim, int64_t topk, int64_t expert_hidden,
616	    const Tensor& d_head_out,        // [N, 1]
617	    Tensor& d_Wq, Tensor& d_A, Tensor& d_B,
618	    Tensor& d_expert_W1, Tensor& d_expert_b1,
619	    Tensor& d_expert_W2, Tensor& d_expert_b2)
620	{
621	    const auto N = peer_input.size(0);
622	    const int64_t half = d_model / 2;
623	    const int64_t num_active = topk * topk;
624	    const double T = 10.0;
625	
626	    // ---- recompute forward ----
627	    auto query = torch::mm(peer_input, Wq.t());            // [N, d_model]
628	    auto q_a = query.index({Slice(), Slice(0, half)});     // [N, half]
629	    auto q_b = query.index({Slice(), Slice(half, d_model)});
630	    auto scores_a = torch::mm(q_a, A.t());                 // [N, pk_dim]
631	    auto scores_b = torch::mm(q_b, B.t());
632	    auto ta = scores_a.topk(topk, -1);
633	    auto tb = scores_b.topk(topk, -1);
634	    auto top_a_vals = std::get<0>(ta), top_a_idx = std::get<1>(ta);  // [N, topk]
635	    auto top_b_vals = std::get<0>(tb), top_b_idx = std::get<1>(tb);
636	    auto soft_a = torch::softmax(top_a_vals * T, -1);      // [N, topk]
637	    auto soft_b = torch::softmax(top_b_vals * T, -1);
638	
639	    auto expert_idx = (top_a_idx.unsqueeze(2) * pk_dim + top_b_idx.unsqueeze(1))
640	                          .reshape({N, num_active});       // [N, A] long
641	    auto routing_w = (soft_a.unsqueeze(2) * soft_b.unsqueeze(1))
642	                          .reshape({N, num_active});       // [N, A]
643	
644	    auto eidx_flat = expert_idx.reshape({-1});             // [N*A]
645	    auto W1 = expert_W1.index_select(0, eidx_flat).reshape({N, num_active, expert_hidden, 1});
646	    auto b1 = expert_b1.index_select(0, eidx_flat).reshape({N, num_active, expert_hidden});
647	    auto W2 = expert_W2.index_select(0, eidx_flat).reshape({N, num_active, 1, expert_hidden});
648	    auto b2 = expert_b2.index_select(0, eidx_flat).reshape({N, num_active, 1});
649	
650	    auto g_exp = g.reshape({N, 1, 1, 1}).expand({N, num_active, 1, 1});  // [N,A,1,1]
651	    auto pre_z = torch::matmul(W1, g_exp).squeeze(-1) + b1;  // [N,A,H]
652	    auto z = torch::relu(pre_z);                            // [N,A,H]
653	    auto out = torch::matmul(W2, z.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)
654	                 + b2.squeeze(-1);                          // [N,A]
655	
656	    // ---- backward ----
657	    // head_out = (routing_w * out).sum(1, keepdim)
658	    auto d_ho = d_head_out.reshape({N, 1});                // [N,1]
659	    auto d_routing_w = d_ho * out;                         // [N,A]
660	    auto d_out = d_ho * routing_w;                         // [N,A]
661	
662	    // out = (W2 . z) + b2  → d_b2, d_W2, d_z
663	    // W2:[N,A,1,H] z:[N,A,H]
664	    d_expert_b2.index_add_(0, eidx_flat, d_out.reshape({N * num_active, 1}));
665	    auto d_W2 = (d_out.unsqueeze(-1) * z).reshape({N * num_active, 1, expert_hidden}); // [N*A,1,H]
666	    d_expert_W2.index_add_(0, eidx_flat, d_W2);
667	    auto W2_flat = W2.reshape({N, num_active, expert_hidden});  // squeeze dim 2
668	    auto d_z = d_out.unsqueeze(-1) * W2_flat;              // [N,A,H]
669	
670	    // z = relu(pre_z) → d_pre_z
671	    auto d_pre_z = d_z * (pre_z > 0).to(torch::kFloat32);  // [N,A,H]
672	    // pre_z = (W1 . g) + b1 ; W1:[N,A,H,1], g scalar
673	    d_expert_b1.index_add_(0, eidx_flat, d_pre_z.reshape({N * num_active, expert_hidden}));
674	    auto g_bc = g.reshape({N, 1, 1}).expand({N, num_active, expert_hidden});  // [N,A,H]
675	    auto d_W1 = (d_pre_z * g_bc).reshape({N * num_active, expert_hidden, 1});
676	    d_expert_W1.index_add_(0, eidx_flat, d_W1);
677	    // d wrt g (scalar) flows nowhere here (g is grad input, no param/peer_input).
678	
679	    // routing_w = (soft_a ⊗ soft_b) reshaped → d_soft_a, d_soft_b
680	    auto d_rw = d_routing_w.reshape({N, topk, topk});      // [N,topk,topk]
681	    auto d_soft_a = (d_rw * soft_b.unsqueeze(1)).sum(2);   // [N,topk]
682	    auto d_soft_b = (d_rw * soft_a.unsqueeze(2)).sum(1);   // [N,topk]
683	
684	    // soft = softmax(vals*T) → d_vals
685	    auto sa_dot = (d_soft_a * soft_a).sum(-1, true);
686	    auto d_top_a_vals = soft_a * (d_soft_a - sa_dot) * T;  // [N,topk]
687	    auto sb_dot = (d_soft_b * soft_b).sum(-1, true);
688	    auto d_top_b_vals = soft_b * (d_soft_b - sb_dot) * T;
689	
690	    // top_a_vals = gather(scores_a, top_a_idx) → scatter back to scores_a
691	    auto d_scores_a = torch::zeros_like(scores_a);         // [N, pk_dim]
692	    d_scores_a.scatter_(1, top_a_idx, d_top_a_vals);
693	    auto d_scores_b = torch::zeros_like(scores_b);
694	    d_scores_b.scatter_(1, top_b_idx, d_top_b_vals);
695	
696	    // scores_a = q_a @ A.t() → d_q_a, d_A
697	    d_A.add_(torch::mm(d_scores_a.t(), q_a));              // [pk_dim, half]
698	    d_B.add_(torch::mm(d_scores_b.t(), q_b));
699	    auto d_q_a = torch::mm(d_scores_a, A);                 // [N, half]
700	    auto d_q_b = torch::mm(d_scores_b, B);
701	
702	    // query = [q_a | q_b]; query = peer_input @ Wq.t() → d_Wq, d_peer_input
703	    auto d_query = torch::cat({d_q_a, d_q_b}, -1);         // [N, d_model]
704	    d_Wq.add_(torch::mm(d_query.t(), peer_input));         // [d_model, peer_in]
705	    auto d_peer_input = torch::mm(d_query, Wq);            // [N, peer_in]
706	    return d_peer_input;
707	}

342	            jnp.matmul(ew2, z_hidden[..., None]).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)
